cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The family photo failed because someone blinked. We need a blinking rota.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then we'll rehearse unscheduled blinking before each photograph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We should appoint someone to monitor rehearsal duration.
